Short title and commencement

ACT XXI OF 1973
ACT XXI OF 1973
SHORT
TITLES ACT, 1973
1. Short title
and commencement.‑(1) This Act may be called the Short Titles Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Refer to schedule

ACT XXI OF 1973
ACT XXI OF 1973
SHORT
TITLES ACT, 1973
2. The laws specified in the first two columns of
the Schedule to this Act, being laws specified in the First and the Seventh
Schedules to the Interim Constitution, shall be cited and referred to by the
short titles mentioned against each in the third column of the Schedule to this
Act.

Repeal

ACT XXI OF 1973
ACT XXI OF 1973
SHORT
TITLES ACT, 1973
3. Repeal.‑The
Short Titles Ordinance, 1972 (LXV of 1972) is hereby repealed.
